reason: Honestly the 'no wall of red' bit is the first planner pitch that's spoken to me, so I'd grab the free plan or the no-card trial. But I just cancelled a $20 planner, I know my pattern: two great weeks, then I stop opening it, so I'm not paying anything in month one.
objection: 'When a block ends, Moduo asks: done, push, shrink or drop' sounds like a popup interrupting me every hour. That is nagging with nicer words, and the moment it feels like a check-in I'm failing, I'm gone. Also it wants my notes, contacts and email too, and I'm not moving my whole life into a new app again.
would_change_my_mind: If I'm still opening it daily after the trial and those end-of-block prompts can be ignored or batched without anything piling up, I'd pay the $12.
